Zane Okoro is a reliable, creative developer who consistently delivers high-quality mobile solutions. As a Senior Mobile Developer at NexaSphere, he balances technical rigor with a collaborative mindset, making him a trusted contributor to our small team.  

Zane’s technical versatility shines through his work with Flutter and React Native, where he consistently builds scalable, cross-platform apps that meet tight deadlines. His recent Flutter migration of our analytics dashboard reduced build times by 30% without sacrificing performance. He also leads state management implementations using Riverpod, ensuring our code remains modular and maintainable. While his iOS work with Swift and UIKit is more niche, he’s reliably produced polished, accessible interfaces for our enterprise clients.  

Beyond coding, Zane’s strength lies in his ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. He actively mentors junior developers, sharing insights on TypeScript best practices and accessibility standards. His attention to detail ensures our apps comply with WCAG guidelines, a priority for our SaaS clients.  

Zane’s impact extends beyond his desk. He regularly collaborates with designers and product managers to refine workflows, and his willingness to experiment with new tools—like integrating WebAssembly for performance gains—keeps our stack modern. His reliability and curiosity make him an asset to any team.  

I recommend Zane without reservation. His technical depth, collaborative spirit, and commitment to quality align perfectly with the demands of a fast-paced SaaS environment.
